bull.point: Management successfully delivered on key FY26 targets, including 17.5 million new customer additions and 22.4% AUM growth.
The company demonstrated disciplined cost management by achieving a 7.41% cost of funds, beating the 7.55–7.6% guidance range.
Management has proactively lowered FY27 credit cost guidance to 145–160 bps, signaling confidence in asset quality.

bear.point: The company missed its FY26 MSME business growth target of 10–12%, achieving only 6% growth.
Several strategic targets, including FY26 fee revenue and FY27 ROA guidance, have gone quiet without updates after the periods ended.
The gold loan portfolio contribution of 4.1% is currently behind the 5% target set for FY27.
